Bramble jolts in place, both shoulders spring high, both amber eyes open extremely wide and the mouth forms a large silent gasp. The free paw turns over urgently beside the waist as Bramble looks at the empty paw, searches once to the opposite side, then makes a sharp double-take toward the shield that was safely attached all along. The discovery changes the face from genuine astonishment to sheepish relief. Keep both feet planted; never hide, drop, detach, duplicate or transform the shield, and create no runes, leaf wisps, new props, floor marks or magical effects.
